verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published overage fee schedule for Workers. Nothing gives per-unit prices for exceeding invocation, bandwidth, or build-minute limits. The only billing-related item (docs-15) describes the billing model of charging for compute rather than wall time, not overage rates. The CPU-time limits mentioned in community posts are plan limits, not fees.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
